name: Trace closure
definition: Every transition has a valid O0-O6 provenance chain.

name: State availability
definition: Required states are finite and present at every recursive level.

name: Agent identifiability
definition: Agent channels retain distinguishable state information.

name: Master reconstructability
definition: Recorded Master state is recoverable without state substitution.

name: Self-error observability
definition: Meta-uncertainty retains ordered information about Master uncertainty.

name: Channel separability
definition: The recursive telemetry spans more than one independent channel.

name: Failure sensitivity
definition: A condition-specific metric detects controlled loss of each required channel.
acceptance_rule: all failure tests: effect > 0.05 and severity Spearman < -0.70

name: Recursive non-redundancy
definition: At least one higher observer level adds held-out reconstruction information.

name: Cross-system invariance
definition: Controlled failures produce concordant signatures across biological systems.
